summary_paragraph: Mr. Thompson, a right-handed male with mixed Hodgkin's and non-Hodgkin's lymphoma involving the central nervous system and eyes, was admitted for his ninth maintenance cycle of high-dose methotrexate and third dose of rituximab. He had a history of mild rituximab allergy, so he was pre-medicated with dexamethasone, Benadryl, and acetaminophen, and tolerated the infusion without reaction. Methotrexate was administered safely without need for leucovorin rescue or bicarbonate, as his kidney function remained stable. A follow-up MRI showed no interval changes and no evidence of lymphoma recurrence. His hospital course was uncomplicated, with stable vital signs and no neurological decline. He was discharged home on a prednisone taper, aspirin, and bowel regimen, with instructions to monitor for fever or other concerns and to follow up with oncology and ophthalmology.
